dekametric.m: Another spelling of decametric. decametric: of, relating to, or measured using a decametre/decametre.

deke.m: A feint, fake, or other move made by the player with the puck to deceive a goaltender or defenceman.

deked.m: Past tense of deke. deke: a feint, fake, or other move made by the player with the puck to deceive a goaltender or defenceman.

dekes.m: More than one deke. deke: a feint, fake, or other move made by the player with the puck to deceive a goaltender or defenceman.

deking.m: The -ing form of deke. deke: a feint, fake, or other move made by the player with the puck to deceive a goaltender or defenceman.
